content:
You are re-judging a repaired Chinese lab report DOCX (虚拟仪器实验报告 实验3：基于NI myDAQ和myQuake设备的加速度计信号采集) rendered via LibreOffice → PDF → PNG 150dpi. Word is authoritative for fonts; ignore minor font substitution. Previous defect: entirely blank trailing page 4. Fix applied: removed trailing empty paragraphs (document is now 3 pages).

Read and judge each page PNG:
- C:\Users\UserX\.zcode\workspace\default\vi_report\render\exp3_p1.png (cover)
- C:\Users\UserX\.zcode\workspace\default\vi_report\render\exp3_p2.png
- C:\Users\UserX\.zcode\workspace\default\vi_report\render\exp3_p3.png

Expected: cover with underlined 报告题目 filled (实验3：基于NI myDAQ和myQuake设备的加速度计信号采集); on content pages the centered title 实验名称→实验3：… then sections 一、实验目的 / 二、实验材料 / 三、实验内容及原理 / 四、实验步骤、过程记录 / 五、实验结果 with content; one screen photo with centered caption 图1 加速度计信号采集前面板运行照片 in 五、实验结果.

Check: no section heading stranded as last line of a page with its content starting on the next page; no text clipped; photo intact, caption centered, nothing overflowing; no blank pages; no tofu/garbled chars (moiré in the screen photo is inherent to the source photo).

Known intentional blanks (NOT issues): 成绩 box empty, 班级/学号/姓名 underlines empty, trailing whitespace at end of document is fine.

Return one JSON verdict line per page: {"page": N, "verdict": "pass"|"fail", "issues": ["..."]}, then a one-line overall summary.

thinking: Let me read the three page images one by one and judge them.

Page 1 (cover): The title 某985高校 / 实验报告 / (2026-2027 学年秋季学期) is present. 报告题目: filled with 实验3：基于 NI myDAQ 和 myQuake 设备的加速度计信号采集 — the underline wraps to a second line, which is expected since the title is long. 课程名称: 虚拟仪器实验, 任课教师: 陈度. 班级/学号/姓名 empty — known intentional. 成绩 box empty — intentional. No clipping, no tofu. The underline on the second line "myQuake 设备的加速度计信号采集_" — there seems to be a trailing underscore-like extension, that's just the underline. Looks fine. Verdict: pass.

Now page 2.

Page 2: Centered title 实验3：基于 NI myDAQ 和 myQuake 设备的加速度计信号采集 (wraps two lines, centered — fine). Sections 一、实验目的, 二、实验材料, 三、实验内容及原理 with content. The page ends with the paragraph "激振由偏心电机实现：NI ELVISmx 函数发生器产生脉冲，通过改变占空比（%Full Scale）调节电机转速，转速越高，结构受到的交变激励越大。" — that completes section 三's paragraph (the paragraph ends with a full stop). No heading stranded at bottom. No clipping visible. No tofu. Verdict: pass.

Now page 3.

Page 3: Section 四、实验步骤、过程记录 with 5 numbered steps, complete. Section 五、实验结果 with the screen photo — the photo appears intact (a photo of a monitor showing LabVIEW front panel with waveform chart, moiré is inherent to source photo — noted as not an issue). Caption "图 1 加速度计信号采集前面板运行照片" — appears centered under the photo. Let me check: the photo spans roughly x=205 to x=1040, center ≈ 622. The caption "图 1 加速度计信号采集前面板运行照片" appears at roughly x=420–790, center ≈ 605. Page center is ~617. Looks centered enough. Then two paragraphs of result description. No heading stranded, no clipping, no blank page. Document ends after that paragraph — trailing whitespace fine.

Everything checks out. All three pages pass.
